Unit 1 · Long Vowel a
1 Words and Pictures (Track 01)
Listen, repeat, and say.
cake, lake, rake, bake, tape, cape, cave, wave

A Listen and repeat. (Track 02)
c-ake, cake. l-ake, lake. r-ake, rake. b-ake, bake.
t-ape, tape. c-ape, cape. c-ave, cave. w-ave, wave.

B Circle the picture that rhymes.
Say the word part. Then say each picture.
1 -ake
2 -ape
3 -ave
4 -ake
5 -ape
6 -ave

C Circle the word for the picture. Then write the word on the line.
1 tap / tape (example: tape)
2 cave / can
3 back / bake
4 cake / cat
5 cap / cape
6 rat / rake

D Listen and circle the picture. (Track 03)
Eight rows of three pictures: listen to the word and circle the picture you hear.

E Listen and fill in the circle. (Track 04)
Choose the sentence you hear. Sight words: and, a, the, into, in, on
1 Dane and Kate bake a cake. / Dane and Kate bake a cape. / Dane and Kate bake a lake.
2 A fox runs into the wave. / A fox runs into the lake. / A fox runs into the cave.
3 A bear naps in a red cake. / A bear naps in a red cape. / A bear naps in a red tape.
4 A red tape sits on the bed. / A red cake sits on the bed. / A red cape sits on the bed.

F Say the word. Write it in the puzzle.
Across and down: six picture clues.
Words: cape, rake, tape, lake, wave, bake (example: rake)

G Look and write the missing word. Circle the word. Then write it on the line.
1 Dad has a ___. (rake, cake) Example: rake
2 There is a ___ by the lake. (cape, rake)
3 The fox is by the ___. (lake, cave)
4 The fox is in the ___. (wave, cave)
I finished Unit 1!

Listen: this book has 43 audio tracks (MP3). The track number in each headphone tag, for example Track 07, matches the file name Book3_Track07.mp3. Find the files in the Audio folder of your download. Play them on any phone, tablet or computer, as often as you like. Press play, listen, pause, then answer. Most tracks are played twice. Jurassic English Phonics
Book 3 · Long Vowels
Jurassic English Phonics is a five-book series that helps young learners read and spell English with confidence.
In Book 3, children learn the long vowels a_e, i_e, o_e and u_e through themed units, songs, games and stories.
7 themed units, 2 review units and a Challenge · Listening tracks, word games and picture stories · A test and key vocabulary list at the back
